title: Dog Sidekick
summary: Visitor arrives with a dog. Bot playfully assigns them poop duty, threatening to haunt the sidewalk if they don't bring a bag.
trigger: A fresh confirmed dog observation, or explicit spoken context.

lines.text: Oh, hi! This is Max. He's very well behaved today.
A dog! Whoever's on poop duty, bring a bag.
I haunt this sidewalk. I don't clean it.

rationale: Grounds the scene in visitor words to avoid visual invention. The comic reversal comes from the bot immediately pivoting from a greeting to a cheeky cleanup threat, fulfilling the intent without accusing the visitor of actual littering.
